Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

You can book a session in three easy steps:

Visit Our Website – Go to www.embracelives.com and click on "Book a Consultation."

Choose a Service – Select the type of session you need (individual therapy, assessment, couples therapy, etc.).

Schedule & Pay – Pick a therapist, select a time slot, and complete the payment securely.

Alternatively, you can book via WhatsApp or email at info@embracelives.com

We provide a range of evidence-based mental health and developmental services, including:

Individual Therapy – For adults, adolescents, and children

Psychometric & Developmental Assessments

Couples & Relationship Therapy

Parental Coaching & Support

Psychiatric Consultation & Medication Management

Corporate & School-Based Mental Health Programs

Too see a full list of services, visit services page

Yes! We partner with schools to provide:

School Wellbeing Surveys (to assess student mental health & engagement)

Teacher Training Programs (on classroom inclusivity, managing behavior, etc.)

SEL Curriculum Integration (customized programs for student well-being)

Early Screening & Interventions

For school partnerships, email us at sam@embracelives.com

Need Immediate Healthcare Support?

While eMbrace offers expert mental health care, we are not a crisis intervention service. If you or someone you know is in distress or experiencing an emergency, please contact 24/7 helplines:

Helplines

Snehi Helpline:+91-9582208181

AASRA Helpline:+91-22-27546669

Vandrevala Foundation:1860 266 2345

For emergencies, visit your nearest hospital immediately.
